Are you technically and practically minded and do you enjoy working with your hands on large, impressive projects? Do you like tinkering, getting things done and working together in a team? Then this full-time position as Aviation Assembly Technician is exactly what you are looking for. You will receive a direct contract with the employer, a good salary and plenty of opportunities to further develop yourself within technology and aviation. Read on!

Manpower is looking for an assembly mechanic for a company in Enschede.

As an aviation assembly technician, you will work together with colleagues on the disassembly, assembly and maintenance of aviation components. Your work is varied and hands-on in nature.

Your tasks will include:

    - Disassembling and assembling technical components according to fixed guidelines
    
- Inspecting, securing and processing components
    
- Working together with experienced colleagues and learning new skills
    
- Working in the workshop and on location
    
- Working according to safety and quality regulations

What's in it for you

    - Gross monthly salary between €3,200 and €3,700
    
- Full-time position (40 hours per week)
    
- Direct contract with the employer
    
- 25 vacation days
    
- Bonus scheme: an extra month’s salary paid at the end of the year
    
- Travel allowance of €0.23 per kilometer
    
- Room for personal development and career growth opportunities
    
- Working in an enthusiastic team with a passion for technology and aviation

    - Technical insight and at least MBO-level working and thinking ability
    
- Experience as a mechanic or technician is a plus (for example in aviation or automotive engineering)
    
- Practical, solution-oriented and a true team player
    
- Good command of the English language
    
- No problem with working outdoors

Does this sound like your next step in technology? Don’t wait any longer and apply directly. We will contact you soon to discuss the possibilities with you!

Hey there! 👋 Do you like to work with a close international team and are you a good organizer?  Are you a big fan of computers and other IT related products? Then we have the perfect job for you: Warehouse Employee! You will help keep big computer systems working well. It's a steady job and a place where being careful is important. ✨ Ready to start? Read more! 👇

What we offer
- Salary: € 14,99 per hour!
- Temporary with a view to the long term
- Work in a small but fun team
- Working hours: 08:00 - 17:00
- Every 3 weeks you'll work in the weekend
- Bonus of 50% on Saturday and 100% on Sunday!

Who you are
You are a careful person who likes to work hard! 💪 You follow directions well, you can work by yourself, and you are a good team player. You should be able to lift up to 25 kg. Safety is important to you! 🛡️

- You speak the English language;
- VOG: you want to apply for a Certificate of Conduct (reimbursed);

What will you do
You will do many different tasks in the warehouse. 🛠️ For example:

- Set up and move parts: Put new parts in and move old parts out.
- Help with shipping: Receive computer parts and send them out.
- Do general warehouse jobs: This means picking, packing, scanning, and counting.
- Follow rules carefully: Make sure everything is done correctly in the data center. 💡

Where will you work
You will work at a remote location in Middenmeer. The warehouse is a place where many computers are. 🏢 It can be a bit noisy and warm, but you will be part of a team that works well together.

- Bonus: 50% on Saturday and 100% on Sunday

In this role, you are the guardian of quality for highly specialized processes within an international high-tech company. The company develops, repairs, and inspects critical components for the aerospace, energy, and defense industries. Together with your team, you work every day to achieve the highest standards of quality and safety.

Your attention to detail and expertise in handling valuable and delicate components make you an essential partner for our customers. In addition, you participate in 5S projects aimed at making work processes safer and more efficient.

You will work in a rotating two-shift schedule: one week in the day shift (five days) and the next week in the evening shift (four days).

- Perform Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) inspections to ensure quality and detect discontinuities or defects using methods such as eddy current testing and ultrasonic testing
- Experience with: Visual inspections, dimensional inspections, receiving inspections and reading and interpreting technical drawings
- Knowledge of and experience with measuring instruments such as calipers and micrometers
- Good command of the English language
